task: put the bowl on top of the cabinet

windows.text: Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward it.
Approach the bowl from above, lowering the open gripper toward its rim.
Grasp the bowl from above by closing the gripper fingers around its rim.
Grasp the bowl on the table and lift it slightly upward.
Lift the bowl up off the table, lifting it above the dark bottle.
Lift the bowl up off the table, moving it toward the dark cabinet.
Carry the bowl horizontally toward the dark cabinet, moving it over the bottle.
Lower the bowl down onto the top surface of the dark cabinet.
Release the bowl onto the top of the cabinet and retract the empty gripper upward.
Open the gripper and readjust above the bowl resting on the cabinet.
